g.text: Record actionable findings against inspected scope
Assign corrections to the proper owner within authority
Correct the subjects and perform relevant checks
review prepare: update current scope after checks
Confirm the actual committed correction result
Return revised scope and affected interactions
Request material-change reassessment in the same gate
review show: read revised basis and earlier support
Return scope, open issues and retained support
Inspect material corrections and affected interactions
review record: update assessment and explicit applicability
Return the current judgment and its applicability
